name: Aleph-7
summary: Aleph-7, or ALEPH-7, also known as 4-propylthio-2,5-dimethoxyamphetamine, is a psychedelic drug of the phenethylamine, amphetamine, and DOx families. It is one of the Aleph series of compounds.

pharmacology.text: It is a potent agonist of the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor, with an EC50 of 2.2 to 7.6 nM and an Emax of 116 to 189%. The drug is also a weak monoamine oxidase inhibitor (MAOI), specifically a reversible inhibitor of MAO-A (RIMA), with an IC50 of 2.4 μM.

uses.text: The drug was encountered as a novel designer drug in Europe in 2005.
